verdict.rationale: Wave offers fixed-purpose recurring automations: recurring invoices with automatic or manual billing, automatic credit card payments, and overdue reminders on a preset 3/7/14-day schedule (Pro). It has no general way to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, and its marketing pages document no API, CLI, or webhook surface for programmatic scheduling. Missing for 10: general-purpose job/workflow scheduling, custom cron-style schedules beyond invoices and reminders, a documented programmatic or AI-native scheduling interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.
